parties: Birla Cable Limited (Transferor) & Vindhya Telelinks Limited (Transferee)
headline: Birla Cable merger with Vindhya Telelinks clears stock exchange nod
sum: Birla Cable Limited received no-objection letters from NSE and no adverse observations from BSE for its proposed scheme of amalgamation with Vindhya Telelinks Limited under the Companies Act, 2013.
implication: Stock exchange approval is a critical gating item in s.230–232 amalgamations; receipt of NOCs signals imminent NCLT filing and heightens likelihood of shareholder-creditor voting and court confirmation.
detail: Birla Cable (transferor) is merging into Vindhya Telelinks (transferee) via a scheme under ss.230–232 of the Companies Act, 2013. NSE and BSE have issued formal observation letters-NSE with a no-objection position, BSE with no adverse remarks-clearing stock exchange regulatory gates. The scheme now moves toward NCLT filing for sanction and subsequent shareholder-creditor voting under s.230.
